about_the_game:
Creature Evolution is a simple game about merging little creatures and seeing what they turn into.

You start with a few small critters, and by combining them, they slowly change into new and sometimes unexpected forms. Experiment with dozens of combinations to discover unique evolutions, and watch your creatures grow bigger and stranger with every merge. As they evolve, they’ll move to new habitats, exploring larger spaces.

Features

  • Merge & Evolve – Combine creatures to unlock new, surprising forms.

  • Dozens of Combinations – Experiment with different merges to see what appears.

  • Progressive Growth – Creatures get bigger and stranger the more you merge.

  • Changing Habitats – Change habitats as your creatures grow bigger and explore new spaces.

  • Retro Pixel Art Style – A nostalgic look inspired by classic handheld games.

  • Relaxing Gameplay – Enjoy simple, stress-free gameplay as you merge creatures and watch them evolve.
